snippet.title: Pizza Slice | Official Date Announcement
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1385290/Pizza_Slice

PIZZA SLICE WILL LAUNCH ON STEAM MARCH 04!

Pizza Slice is a crazy and humorous restaurant simulation in which the player has to run an entire pizzeria, including shopping for ingredients, doing prep work, cleaning, serving and of course preparing the dishes. 

Pizza Slice will also feature a cooperative mode between two players in the campaign mode.

Play demo here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4011090/Pizza_Slice_Demo
